Name: Shared Professions
Author: virtualbjorn
Description:
Your farmhand friend is offline and you badly need his/her profession benefits to sell or do something?
Worry not! Shared Professions is here for you!

This mod aims to not modify your save file. The mod will only apply the benefits of the mod [b]AFTER [/b]the game is saved and will apply your vanilla professions [b]BEFORE[/b] your game is saved. If you encounter issues with professions not reverting during the saving process. You can reach out to me to help you resolve your issue.

This mod creates a JSON file with your Farm Name to Save the Original Professions Data.

[b]Reminders:
[/b]When updating combat professions config i.e Health modifiers the lowest health set will be [b]20 by default[/b].

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI
[/url]Extract the ZIP file and Copy [b]SharedProfessions [/b]to your mods folder.

Mod now supports [b]Configurations[/b]


You can further support me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/virtualbjorn]Ko-Fi[/url]
